_comment: "If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, this gets +4{p}. Decompose - When this attacks, you may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, each hero puts a card from their ARSENAL on the bottom of their deck." Deliberately mirrors felling_of_the_crown_red, which is the same two clauses with the same numbers; only the Decompose payoff differs (felling bottoms from HAND, this from ARSENAL, so PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM rather than PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM). face_up:true on the banished-zone count because a face-down banished card is not publicly an Earth card, and the count is of what is there face up. The two ability-level CARD_IN_ZONE conditions gate whether the option is OFFERED, so by the time the MAY is accepted the cost is payable and the payoff effects can sit beside the banishes -- the same shape felling uses. card_class 'Earth' matches the Earth talent via _card_traits, and filter_types ['Action'] checks types OR subtypes, so 'an action card' includes attack actions as printed. Corpus: 2000 attacks, previously all skipped as unimplemented.

effects.prompt: Decompose - banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard?
